content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can establish a fully operational digital store using the Edge Commerce Stack. This stack combines Cloudflare Pages and Workers for hosting and backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for instant crypto payment processing. You can get set up to accept payments in USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for a minimal fee of under $0.10. This means you can start selling your ebooks, courses, or digital products to a global audience instantly.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the minimum viable stack you need to launch your digital products online. This solution includes everything: secure hosting through Cloudflare, efficient order management with Supabase, and automated payments via NOWPayments. It allows you to load up to five products initially, ensuring that you can start making money right away. Plus, the infrastructure is designed for scalability, so as your business grows, you can easily expand on this foundation.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on essential features that drive immediate results instead of getting bogged down in unnecessary details. Right now, you don’t need to worry about advanced marketing strategies or elaborate websites. Instead, concentrate on deploying your product stack, setting up payment gateways, and ensuring your files are ready for delivery. Once these elements are in place, you can refine your store's design and marketing as you go.
Blockchain payments eliminate the need for traditional banking systems.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, start by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept USDT on the Tron network. Next, link your product files stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless delivery. Once you have your products listed and payment processed, promote your store to potential buyers. The moment your first sale occurs, you’ll have a tested, functioning system that proves this architecture works.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Within the next 24 hours, you can complete the following steps: purchase the Edge Commerce Stack for $197, deploy your store using Cloudflare Pages, connect your NOWPayments account, and upload your digital products to Supabase. After that, configure your file delivery system and test your payment processing. This rapid execution will position you to start generating income in no time.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Your digital store can be live and operational within 48 hours.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.

Yes, using cryptocurrency for transactions is secure, especially with platforms like NOWPayments that ensure payment verification through blockchain technology. This minimizes risks associated with traditional payment systems.
